concepts.label: ① 双人定位
concepts.prompt: Generate ONE premium website/app icon for GoMate, an app for outdoor hiking, city discovery, coffee-shop visits and travel with companions. Output a finished high-resolution raster PNG, square 1:1, ideally 1024x1024 or larger. Only the icon, no presentation board or multiple panels. Brand visual language: elegant but lively, warm welcoming contemporary lifestyle design, tactile refined 3D clay with smooth matte ceramic surfaces and generously rounded shapes, restrained soft ambient occlusion, warm studio light from upper left. Full-bleed opaque softly graduated warm ivory #FFF8EC to pale sand and apricot #F7D8AF background, no enclosing frame or extra icon tile. Main subject in warm amber #D97706 and creamy white #FFFBEB, with very small burnt terracotta accents if needed. No blue, green, purple, chrome, rainbow or cold gray. Composition centered and balanced; subject occupies about 64-68% of canvas, at least 16% clear safety margin on every edge. A single strong unified silhouette that stays identifiable at 32px, few big forms, clearly open cutouts, no tiny details or thin lines. No text, letters, numbers, branding, labels, watermark, busy scenery, pedestal or unrelated ornaments. The image must feel like a memorable distinctive brand mark rather than a generic clip-art scene. CONCEPT: COMPANION LOCATION PIN. One thick plump warm amber map-pin silhouette with a large round upper body tapering to a friendly rounded bottom point. Inside the pin's single large recessed round window, TWO tiny abstract cream companions stand closely side by side: each made of just a rounded head and a smooth rounded shoulder/body block. Their two heads and touching shoulders read as two people, not a pair of eyes or an emoji face. Broad negative-space separation keeps the people clear and integrated with the location pin. The two small companions are the only interior motif: no mountain, cup, buildings, heart, dots, or text. Slight three-quarter sculptural depth while mostly front-facing; the pin remains upright. The chunky pin stands gently on the background with a short soft contact shadow. Strong amber exterior, high-contrast cream interior companions. Delightful and calm: a place and someone to go there with.

Its smooth warm-amber circular coffee surface doubles as a clean compass face. A compact clever readable emblem for discovery and leisure.

Exactly TWO friendly abstract SHOEPRINTS in a gentle parallel diagonal stride, pointing toward upper right. Each footprint is a very simple chunky sculptural shoe sole silhouette, with one broad rounded toe section, slight inward waist and a short rounded separated heel; no individual toes, no shoe laces, no tread pattern or small grooves.
